capabilities.name: Chat
capabilities.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion: POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with {model, messages, venice_parameters:{enable_web_search:'auto', enable_web_citations:true}}. capabilities.name: Image generation
capabilities.description: POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate with {model:'flux-2-pro', prompt, width, height}. Studio UI at /studio/image (edit/upscale/background-remove advertised). Response shape (file url on media.venice.ai vs base64) to-verify.

capabilities.name: Video generation
capabilities.description: POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue with {model:'veo3-full-text-to-video', prompt} — async queue; job-poll/download endpoints to-verify. Studio UI at /studio/video.

capabilities.name: Music / audio generation
capabilities.description: POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue with {model:'stable-audio-25', prompt} — async queue; job-poll/download endpoints to-verify. Studio UI at /studio/audio.
